程序包 com

类 SkillMatchUtil

java.lang.Object
com.SkillMatchUtil
public class SkillMatchUtil extends Object
Utility class for comparing TA skills against job skill requirements.

Provides methods to calculate percentage match scores and detailed matched/missing skill lists for MO applicant review pages.

    • calculateMatchScore

      public static int calculateMatchScore(String jobSkillRequirement, String taSkills)
      Calculate only the numeric match score between a job and a TA skill list.
      参数:
      jobSkillRequirement - comma-separated skills required by the job
      taSkills - comma-separated skills owned by the TA
      返回:
      percentage match score from 0 to 100

    • calculateMatchResult

      public static SkillMatchUtil.MatchResult calculateMatchResult(String jobSkillRequirement, String taSkills)
      Calculate detailed skill matching result for a job requirement and TA skills.
      参数:
      jobSkillRequirement - comma-separated skills required by the job
      taSkills - comma-separated skills owned by the TA
      返回:
      MatchResult containing score, matched skills, and missing skills

    • calculateMatchScores

      public static List<Integer> calculateMatchScores(List<Application> apps, MoApplicantReviewService service)
      Calculate match scores for a list of applications.
      参数:
      apps - applications to evaluate
      service - review service used to load job and TA skill data
      返回:
      list of match scores in the same order as the input applications
